source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"A skill considered to have limited established connection to how effectively a nurse manager leads and retains their team over time","B":"A quality generally viewed as a leadership weakness, since expressing emotion at work is thought to undermine a manager's perceived authority","C":"A concept considered relevant mainly to administrative or corporate roles, with limited application to direct clinical unit leadership","D":"Emotional intelligence, which is associated with more effective leadership, stronger team relationships, and a more positive work environment"}}
source_row.rationale: Emotional intelligence — encompassing self-awareness, self-regulation, empathy, and relationship management skills — is associated with more effective leadership, stronger team relationships, and a more positive, supportive work environment, an increasingly recognized and valued leadership competency in nursing management.
